disposition_reason: Reports cadmium, lead, nickel, chromium and other metals by ICP-OES in two samples each of three traditional rice beverages (two fermented, one distilled) from Kokrajhar, Assam.

study.origin: traditional household production, Bodo community, Kokrajhar district, Assam, India
study.market: collected in Kokrajhar district (purchase point not stated)
study.method: HNO3/H2SO4 hot-plate digestion of 25 mL, ICP-OES (Perkin Elmer)
study.qa: triplicate analysis; no CRM, recovery or blank reported

Text gives Fe "0.859-1.992 mg/mL" and Pb "0.064-0.256 mg/mL", but Table 1 is in mg/L and the highest Pb is 0.250; table used.
K and Na not recorded as findings. No LOD; sampling dates not reported.
Named traditional beverages are recorded under descriptive labels with the sample codes (JB, JF, JG) in the group.
